title: Celestial Cave Vision
description: A woman in a dark blue kimono stands inside an icy cave, reaching upward toward a swirling green and purple galaxy emerging from the ceiling. In the foreground is a potted plant with large green leaves, while a serene landscape with mountains and a pagoda is visible through the cave opening.
prompt: A woman with long dark hair wearing a dark blue floral kimono stands inside a crystal ice cave, reaching her hand up towards a vibrant swirling galaxy of green, purple and blue stars that flows down from the ceiling like a cosmic waterfall. In the foreground sits a potted plant with large green leaves on the snowy ground. Through the cave opening, a peaceful landscape with misty mountains and a traditional pagoda by a lake is visible. Soft glowing flowers float in the air, detailed fantasy digital painting in a serene and mystical style.
